messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#INC-4521 capacity-exhaustion-service-q backlog > 95% for 6m. Severity: P1. Affected: /v1/generate endpoints.

pagerduty: A page has been sent to the eng-oncall rotation. Incident URL: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-4521

sara (oncall): acked. I'm looking. first quick check: is autoscaler at max replicas?

raj: seeing sustained queue length on service-queue (redis list length ~ 132k), workers sat at 60/60. Autoscaler not adding new pods for last 7m.

jamie: logs from scale-controller show repeated "scale request dropped: cooldown" and then a bunch of kubernetes API 429s.

luis (sre): can we bump cluster autoscaler temporarily? node pool at 95% CPU already but pod density could be increased.

anya (pm): customers are seeing 502/timeout errors on chat and some queued messages delayed >30s. Is there customer-visible impact metric we can call out?

raj: yes, 5xx across the /v1/generate route rising to 8%. top customer IDs with errors: cust_238, cust_820, cust_577. Sending list to support.

sara (oncall): immediate mitigation plan: 1) try manual scale up of replica count for the worker deployment to 120 2) temporarily increase autoscaler max from 120->300 3) if nodes are insufficient, request CA to add 4 nodes. I'll execute 1 and 2 now.

sara (oncall): running kubectl patch deployment workers -n inference -p '{"spec":{"replicas":120}}'

deploy-bot: deployment/workers patched (replicas: 60 -> 120) by sara (oncall).

jamie: updating HPA max to 300 now.

luis (sre): submitted node pool scale request to cloud (requested +4 g4dn-like nodes). ETA ~ 3m.

raj: also spotted controller-manager logs: "failed to reconcile HPA: failed to get metrics: prometheus query timeout" — prometheus scraping for custom metrics was flapping. That might explain why HPA wasn't reacting.

sara (oncall): noted. adding prometheus-oncall. @luis can you look at metrics pipeline?

luis (sre): looking. Prometheus alert for scraping_errors fired at same time. Restarting prometheus-scraper pod to clear stuck connections.

deploy-bot: pod/prometheus-scraper restarted by luis (sre).

raj: after manual replica bump, worker queue processed some backlog, 30% drop in list length. But still high. Nodes 2/4 provisioning, should see improved throughput after node readiness.

sara (oncall): status update for page: mitigation in progress, manual replica bump done, autoscaler max raised, nodes requested. Customer impact: intermittent 5xx and increased latency; support notified with top affected customers. Postmortem owner: jamie.

anya (pm): please include rollback/fallback plan in postmortem — some customers on dedicated capacity might need failover.

jamie: capturing action items. I'm grabbing controller logs and prometheus queries for the window 1865003100-1865003300.

pagerduty: Incident INC-4521 acknowledged by sara (oncall).

sara (oncall): escalation policy: if not back to baseline in 10m escalate to SRE lead. Starting 10m timer.

luis (sre): nodes are up. kube nodes Ready: +4. Node autoscaling completed.

raj: we're seeing TPS back to ~85% of normal. Queue length trending down to ~18k. 5xx rate down to 1.2%. Good signal.

sara (oncall): cancel escalation. will keep monitoring for 30m then close page if stable.

jamie: collected controller-manager trace and a snippet showing prometheus query timeouts causing HPA to ignore metrics. saving to /incidents/INC-4521/artifacts.

sara (oncall): creating a short incident summary for support to post to status page: "Degraded service for /v1/generate due to metrics and autoscaler coordination issue; manual scale and node add restored service. Engineers continuing root cause analysis."

anya (pm): posting to status page now (initial update).

pagerduty: Incident INC-4521 status: acknowledged -> in_progress.

jamie: next steps (short term): add retry on prometheus query, add fallback to raw kube metrics if custom metrics unavailable. Long term: fix prometheus scrape reliability and add synthetic canaries for HPA metrics.

luis (sre): I'll open infra ticket to harden metrics pipeline and gate decider for HPA.

sara (oncall): closing the live page in 30m if 5xx < 2% and queue continues downward. thanks all. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: Incident INC-4521 status note: resolved by sara (oncall) at 1865003295.

sara (oncall): resolved. follow-up meeting scheduled for tomorrow 10:00am to do RCA and deployment action items.

anya (pm): thanks — make sure to include customer impact timeline for support.

jamie: will include logs, prometheus query samples, and the patch that will be proposed for HPA fallback.

incident-bot: This thread will be archived after 7 days.
